topics.title: Rajkumar Shukla and the road to Champaran

concepts.learning_objective: Describe how Rajkumar Shukla's persistence brought Gandhi to Champaran.
Trace Gandhi's journey from Lucknow to Muzaffarpur and explain what it reveals about social attitudes of the time.
Explain the 15 per cent indigo arrangement and how synthetic indigo changed it.
Explain why Gandhi held that freedom from fear mattered more to the peasants than law courts.
Analyse how Gandhi's peaceful defiance at Motihari led to the first triumph of civil disobedience in modern India.
Interpret Gandhi's 'conflict of duties' and his appeal to the voice of conscience.

topics.title: The lawyers' resolve, the inquiry and the settlement

concepts.learning_objective: Explain how Gandhi's example changed the attitude of the Bihar lawyers.
Evaluate why Gandhi accepted a 25 per cent refund and what it achieved for the peasants.

topics.title: Social reform, self-reliance and the Gandhian pattern

concepts.learning_objective: Describe the educational, health and sanitation work Gandhi began in Champaran villages.
Explain the lesson in self-reliance Gandhi taught through the Andrews episode.
Interpret why Champaran was a turning point and how Gandhi's politics were tied to people's daily problems.
Identify words related to legal procedures and infer word meanings from context.
Explain the use of direct speech in narration and of the comma with subordinate clauses.
